violations.affected_code: GestureDetector(behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque, onTap: () => onSelected(entry.key), child: SizedBox(... Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: entry.value ...))))
violations.explanation: Each swatch is conveyed only by its color. There is no text or Semantics label using entry.key, so screen reader users cannot tell which color each swatch represents.

GestureDetector exposes only a tap action, not a button or selectable role. Assistive technologies do not announce the swatch as an interactive, selectable control. It should be wrapped in Semantics(button: true, ...) or use InkWell or another Material widget.

violations.affected_code: border: Border.all(color: entry.key == selectedColor ? Colors.black : Colors.transparent, width: 3)
violations.explanation: The selected state is shown only by a visual border. It is not exposed through Semantics(selected: true) or inMutuallyExclusiveGroup, so screen reader users cannot tell which color is currently selected.

violations.type: Custom interactive control lacking keyboard/focus support
violations.explanation: GestureDetector is not focusable and does not respond to keyboard activation, so keyboard and switch-access users cannot select a swatch. A focusable widget such as InkWell, or FocusableActionDetector, should be used.
